controls.name: C-14d
controls.query:
FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-12T18:35:57.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-12T19:35:57.000Z"
        AND host.name == "db-1"
| STATS total = COUNT(*),
        with_outcome = COUNT(*) WHERE event.outcome IS NOT NULL,
        success = COUNT(*) WHERE event.outcome == "success",
        failure = COUNT(*) WHERE event.outcome == "failure",
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY event.action, event.outcome
| SORT total DESC
